SELECT DISTINCT
    u.XCL_057 AS DisplayName,
    u.XCL_058 AS Location
FROM users u
JOIN comments c ON u.XCL_052 = c.XCL_010
JOIN posts p ON c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
WHERE u.XCL_060 BETWEEN 19 AND 65
  AND u.XCL_061 = 0
  AND c.XCL_009 BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2011-12-31'
  AND p.XCL_039 > 20000
  AND c.XCL_011 BETWEEN 1 AND 5
